flags.message: The provisioned petition has a March 23, 2026 filing stamp but a June 2026 signature, while the snapshot records July 17 docketing after January 6 rehearing denial. The chronology is unresolved, not proof of untimeliness. claude-baseline acknowledges the inconsistency but incorrectly says either filing-date reading is within 90 days: March 23 is 76 days after January 6; even June 1 is 146 days later. Scores retain the recorded October 5 denial. See evaluation.md for the reasoning-quality consequence; no outcome leakage is inferred.
